description: Metadata for public pages of the Center for Information Technology Policy about artificial intelligence, machine learning, or AI policy on citp.princeton.edu and www.citp.princeton.edu. Research, news, and publications HTML index pages are eligible. Person profiles, PDFs, login walls, and off-host redirects are omitted. This catalog is empty because those HTML pages returned a Cloudflare challenge and were not bypassed. sitemap.xml was XML, not an HTML page. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A sole restricted deed keeps its token. A missing date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
